label: TP
reason: Assessed alert path: User input from getQueryString() flows through substring extraction and URL decoding into doSomething(). Although doSomething() replaces the last character of param with 'Z', this mitigation is insufficient to prevent XSS (e.g., <script> tags remain functional even if the closing bracket is altered). The sink println(bar.toCharArray()) outputs the modified string directly to the response without HTML entity encoding, allowing attacker-controlled data to reach the sink expression.

evidence.note: Data flows from getQueryString to toCharArray sink; weak character replacement does not sanitize XSS payload
